# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 18 budget tracking tests pass: test_total_n_helper_sums_all_pools, test_total_c_helper_sums_all_pools, test_budget_component_labels_cover_all_element_bearing_fields, test_budget_path_rules_catch_convention_based_future_fields, test_closed_system_n_conservation, test_closed_system_c_conservation, test_periphyton_capacity_excess_routes_to_dissolved_organics, test_algae_loss_routing_is_clamped_to_available_biomass, test_plant_loss_routing_is_clamped_to_available_biomass, test_trim_plants_preserves_n_and_c_when_routed_to_detritus, test_clean_filter_routes_removed_microbes_to_dissolved_organics, test_closed_system_shrimp_mortality_conserves_n_and_c, test_closed_system_shrimp_reproduction_conserves_n_and_c, test_water_change_n_export_tracked, test_water_change_tracks_gross_n_import_and_export, test_dissolved_oxygen_stage_tracks_gross_in_and_out, test_preset_dic_exchange_is_treated_as_open_system_carbon, test_budget_ledger_zero_cost_when_disabled
- Full tank_core test suite passes with 0 failures across all test binaries
- cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings passes with zero warnings
- Acceptance criterion 1 (inspect per-tick budget deltas): BudgetLedger stores TickBudgetRecord with per-stage BudgetEntry deltas; tests like test_water_change_n_export_tracked and test_dissolved_oxygen_stage_tracks_gross_in_and_out inspect individual stage entries by label and verify in_mg/out_mg values
- Acceptance criterion 2 (closed-system ticks show near-zero net delta): test_closed_system_n_conservation and test_closed_system_c_conservation run 24 ticks with active biology (algae, microbes, microfauna, detritus) and assert per-tick net deltas < 1e-6 plus total conservation < 1e-6
- Acceptance criterion 3 (zero-cost when disabled): budget_ledger is Option<BudgetLedger> (engine.rs:27), defaults to None, and maybe_record_stage (engine.rs:237-256) only computes BudgetSnapshot when tick.is_some(). test_budget_ledger_zero_cost_when_disabled verifies no ledger allocation during 2 steps when tracking is disabled
- Canonical total_nitrogen_mg (budget.rs:341-346) sums 16 components defined in nitrogen_budget_components (budget.rs:170-258): ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, DON, substrate_layers[*].nutrient_store_mg_n_total, plant guilds, suspended/periphyton algae, decomposer/AOB/NOB/comammox biomass, adult/juvenile shrimp, particulate/fine detritus. Substrate N inclusion satisfies the reviewer correction.
- Canonical total_carbon_mg (budget.rs:348-353) sums 13 components defined in carbon_budget_components (budget.rs:268-339): DIC, DOC, plant guilds, algae, microbes, shrimp, detritus. dissolved_feed_residue_g_total explicitly excluded with documented rationale (mirrors DOC/DON).
- TankState exposes total_nitrogen(), total_carbon(), budget_totals() (state.rs:241-251) all delegating to BudgetTotals::from_state(), providing a single canonical definition point
- Runtime conservation guard at engine.rs:504-529 returns SimError::BudgetImbalance with element, delta_mg, tick_index, day, hour when a closed-system tick exceeds 1e-6 tolerance
- Budget guard uses flux-based open/closed determination (engine.rs:544-578): tick_has_closed_system_nitrogen/carbon checks entry_has_open_action_flux which requires both matching label AND non-zero ElementBudget flux, preventing no-op actions from suppressing the guard. Unit tests at engine.rs:597-662 verify this.
- CleanFilter (engine.rs:354-383) now routes removed microbe biomass to dissolved organics via route_live_biomass_to_dissolved_organics (engine.rs:532-542), treating it as a closed-system internal transfer. test_clean_filter_routes_removed_microbes_to_dissolved_organics verifies N/C conservation and DON/DOC increase.
- Gross budget recording via from_snapshots (budget.rs:54-61) uses gross_element_budget (budget.rs:444-462) to sum per-component gains and losses separately, providing bidirectional in/out visibility rather than net-only
- Explicit gross budgets for water_change (via apply_water_change_with_budget) and dissolved_oxygen (via step_dissolved_oxygen_with_budget) provide separate in/out terms for the most important bidirectional stages
- Structural coverage guard (budget_tracking.rs:320-356) serializes TankState to JSON, walks all numeric paths, filters by convention-based patterns (*_mg_n_total, *_mg_c_total, *biomass_g, detritus/animal shared patterns), and asserts exact equality with canonical helper component labels
- All 6 acceptance-criteria tests from the reviewer comments are present and passing: (1) test_total_n_helper_sums_all_pools, (2) test_total_c_helper_sums_all_pools, (3) test_closed_system_n_conservation, (4) test_closed_system_c_conservation, (5) test_water_change_n_export_tracked, (6) test_budget_ledger_zero_cost_when_disabled
- Test helpers use manually defined stoichiometric functions (manual_organic_nitrogen_mg, manual_live_biomass_nitrogen_mg, etc. at budget_tracking.rs:198-216) with hardcoded constants independent of library helpers, providing genuine cross-validation
- Per-stage granular recording covers all 12 PlayerAction variants (exhaustive match in action_budget_label, engine.rs:487-501) plus all system stages (temperature, nitrogen_cycle, chemistry, dissolved_oxygen, shrimp_stress, hourly_events, invariants, daily_plants, daily_algae, daily_microfauna, stability_tracker, daily_shrimp, daily_filter_clogging, daily_biofilter_maturity)
- Oxygen tracking covers dissolved_oxygen_mg_total via BudgetTotals.oxygen_mg (budget.rs:75), consistent with the 'track where feasible' deliverable wording

## Findings and Gaps

- The convention-based field discovery in the structural coverage test catches fields matching *_mg_n_total, *_mg_c_total, *biomass_g, and shared detritus/animal patterns. A future element-bearing field with a non-standard suffix would evade detection. The doc comments on nitrogen_budget_components and carbon_budget_components (budget.rs:162-169, 260-267) document this obligation. This is acceptable given Rust's lack of practical compile-time field introspection.
- Shrimp eggs remain implicit (EggCohort has count and progress_days only). Mass is conserved by debiting dissolved pools on hatch/maturation via fund_live_shrimp_biomass_from_water. A first-class egg biomass pool would provide better save-schema clarity but is appropriately deferred.
- Complex multi-process stages like nitrogen_cycle record budgets via snapshot-derived gross component deltas, so same-component turnover within a single stage can still net out. The explicit-budget path addresses the most important bidirectional stages (water_change, dissolved_oxygen). This is acceptable granularity for the current phase.
- The active_budget_state (budget_tracking.rs:57-83) excludes shrimp (adults_count=0) from the 24-tick conservation tests, but dedicated tests (shrimp_mortality at 72 ticks, shrimp_reproduction at 1440 ticks) independently exercise shrimp lifecycle conservation with seeded scenarios.
- CleanFilter was changed from an open-system export (per ROUTING.md) to a closed-system internal transfer routing biomass to dissolved organics. This changes the modeled semantics — ROUTING.md lines 146 and 163 document removed fouling as 'maintenance export'. The new behavior is arguably more conservative for mass conservation but diverges from the documented design. ROUTING.md should be updated to reflect the new routing decision.
- The test_total_n/c_helper_sums_all_pools tests aggregate microbe and shrimp biomass into single sums before applying stoichiometric helpers, rather than computing per-pool independently. Since the underlying formula is linear for non-negative inputs, this is mathematically equivalent and acceptable.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
